name: Genuine Service - Local Police Station Tenant Check (English)

caller_script.text: Namaste Sharma ji, this is Head Constable Yadav calling from your local Indiranagar police station desk.
We are conducting the annual tenant verification drive in sector 4. The verification form for your first floor tenant is pending.
Whenever you are free this week, please drop by the police station between 10 AM and 5 PM with one passport photo and lease copy. Thank you.
